# PCB FIX1 source register — accessed 2026-10-05

All sources below were **REFERENCED only**. No third-party PCB was copied, no upstream source modified, and no vendor document redistributed. Vendor copyright retained; no redistribution license asserted. Project scripts implement our own geometry edits and approximate calculations. Exact project baseline: `470a34a17558f95c9188798e4922b7ac35c2a844`; review snapshot in PCB_REVIEW_R1.md remains historical.

| URL / identity | Revision / relevant material | Function studied / adaptation / attribution |

Adapted placement and routing, no reference PCB copied. TI recommends 2/1/1/2 oz; the authorized JLC 1/0.5/0.5/1 oz remains a thermal departure. Credit Texas Instruments. |

Used for loss screening only. Credit Infineon / International Rectifier. |

No uploaded-board quote, shipping, tax, assembly or special via process included. Credit JLCPCB. |
